tools.description: Create a new playbook. A playbook is a container for personas (AI personalities), skills (capabilities), and memory (persistent storage).

description.description: Description of what the playbook is for

instructions.description: Always-on project instructions (the AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md content). Separate from the persona: the persona is who the agent is, these are the rules of this project.

tools.name: create_playbook

playbook_id.description: UUID of the playbook

playbook_id.description: UUID of the playbook to delete

playbook_id.description: UUID of the playbook

system_prompt.description: The system prompt that defines this persona's behavior

tools.name: create_persona

tools.description: Update a persona's name, system prompt, or metadata.

playbook_id.description: UUID of the playbook

tools.description: List all skills (capabilities/rules) in this playbook Target a playbook with playbook_id.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

tools.name: list_skills

tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific skill Target a playbook with playbook_id.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

tools.name: get_skill

tools.description: Read a specific memory entry by key. Automatically increments access count. Memory supports 3 tiers: 'working' (active scratch pad), 'contextual' (recent context), 'longterm' (archived). Use 'hierarchical' memory_type for complex task graphs with parallel threads. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

tools.name: read_memory

tools.description: Search memories by text, tags, tier, or type. Returns summaries for large memories. Use tags for categorical search; use tier to focus on active vs archived data; use memory_type to find task graphs. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

search.description: Search in keys, descriptions, and summaries

tools.name: search_memory

tools.description: Write a memory entry. Use tier='working' for active tasks, 'contextual' for background context, 'longterm' for completed work. Set memory_type='hierarchical' and parent_key to build task graphs. Use status to track task progress in parallel workflows. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

memory_type.description: flat (default) or hierarchical for task graphs

metadata.description: Graph metadata: dependencies, thread assignment, progress, etc.

parent_key.description: Parent memory key for hierarchical organization

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

tools.name: write_memory

tools.description: Delete a memory entry (requires API key) Target a playbook with playbook_id.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

tools.name: delete_memory

tools.description: Consolidate multiple related memories into a parent memory with summary. Reduces context size while preserving detail access via children. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

tools.name: consolidate_memories

tools.description: Promote a memory to a higher tier or boost its priority for active use. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

target_tier.description: Target tier (cannot demote with this tool)

tools.name: promote_memory

tools.description: Get a context-optimized view of memories. Returns full working memory, summaries for contextual, and keys only for longterm. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

expand_keys.description: Keys to show full content regardless of tier

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

tags_filter.description: Only include memories with these tags

tools.name: get_memory_context

tools.description: Archive memories from working/contextual to longterm tier. Useful for cleaning up after completing tasks. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

older_than_hours.description: Archive memories older than X hours

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

tags.description: Only archive memories with these tags

tools.name: archive_memories

tools.description: Get hierarchical tree view of memories showing parent-child relationships. Use this to visualize task graphs and track parallel operations. Includes status for each node. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

root_key.description: Start from this key (omit for all roots)

tools.name: get_memory_tree

tools.description: Create a hierarchical task plan in one call. Creates a parent 'plan' memory with children for each subtask. Use this for complex multi-threaded work that agent swarms can coordinate on. Each subtask gets its own memory node with status tracking. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

plan_key.description: Key for the root plan memory

plan_summary.description: High-level summary of the entire plan

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

depends_on.description: Keys of tasks this depends on

key.description: Task key (will be prefixed with plan_key/)

tools.name: create_task_graph

tools.description: Update the status of a task node in a hierarchical plan. When all children of a parent are 'completed', the parent is auto-updated. Returns the current subtree state. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

result.description: Task result data to store in value

tools.name: update_task_status

run_id.description: Workflow run UUID. Omit to list documents across all runs.

tools.name: read_canvas

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

tools.name: patch_canvas_section

tools.description: Get the table of contents for a canvas document. Returns section IDs, headings, and levels for navigation and patch_canvas_section. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

tools.name: get_canvas_toc

tools.description: Lock a section for exclusive editing. Prevents other agents from modifying it. Remember to unlock when done. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

tools.name: lock_canvas_section

tools.description: Unlock a previously locked section so other agents can edit it. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

tools.name: list_secrets

tools.description: Make an HTTP request with a secret injected as a header. The secret value is NEVER returned to the agent — it is decrypted and used server-side only. Use this to authenticate API calls without exposing credentials. Example: use_secret({secret_name: 'OPENAI_API_KEY', url: 'https://api.openai.com/v1/models'}) sends GET with 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Requires secrets:read permission. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

header_name.description: Header name to inject the secret into (default: Authorization)

header_prefix.description: Prefix before the secret value (default: 'Bearer '). Use empty string for raw value.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

secret_name.description: Name of the secret to use (e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY)

url.description: The URL to send the HTTP request to

tools.name: use_secret

tools.description: Store a new encrypted secret. The value is encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a per-user derived key and never stored or returned in plaintext. Requires secrets:write permission. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

description.description: What this secret is used for

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

value.description: The secret value to encrypt and store

tools.name: store_secret

tools.description: Rotate (update) an existing secret with a new value. The old value is permanently replaced and cannot be recovered. Requires secrets:write permission. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

tools.name: rotate_secret

tools.description: Permanently delete a secret. Cannot be undone. Requires secrets:write permission. Target a playbook with playbook_id.

playbook_id.description: UUID or GUID of the target playbook

tools.name: delete_secret
